name: Back Office Enquiries
description: An inbox for contact-form messages: new and all filters, a reading pane, reply, tap-to-call and archive. Works as a single column on phones.
usage: Give it the /admin/enquiries route. Load messages from wherever the contact form saves them (Supabase, Formspree's API…), save onStatusChange, and make onReply open an email reply or send one through your email service. Security: put every back-office screen behind sign-in (for example Supabase Auth or Clerk), let only the owner's account read or write this data (in Supabase, with row-level security on every table), and keep admin pages out of the public navigation and sitemap.
